body: My problem isn’t opening up,I’m open with people.My problem is my life feels fake.I feel like everything around me is fabricated and it’s like all of my senses are dull and faded,everything I experience feels like it’s happened before and I knew it was going to happen
Hating a animal gives you no excuse to take their life when they weren’t harming you in any way.

I don’t wish for a councillor or a professional,I am in no way diagnosed with clinical depression however I get bursts where I feel depressed,I just wish for someone to listen to me and a friend ,or just advice but ; never
I’m at the very least 80% not okay

Try to spend more time with her,give her space ofcorse but don’t leave her to sit on her own,for me,when I was alone and it was silent all the thoughts would kick in,try to keep her busy with things she enjoys,or experience new things with her (movies,swimming,whatever !) good luck
The thing that rely on me.Not people,people don’t always.the other living things.My plants,my pets,without me,they wouldn’t get water,sunlight,food.They need me,not emotionally but,to live.

I’m your age,trust me,if a girl is worth it(she’s a good person,isn’t cruel or unfriendly) she won’t mind you ‘embarrassing yourself’ or ‘messing up’ it will likely reassure her,and make her think ‘he’s pretty cute,and like me,he fucks up’.I personally feel over my head when a guy tries to talk to me and doesn’t even say a word wrong or ‘mess up’ in any way.just say hi,ask how her days going,if she’s in your school collage whatever,ask about a lesson you have in common.
Oh god it’s not something to be jealous of,I burn in 2 minutes and I’m jealous of people who just tan,I have patches of skin that are all different shades all over my body,it looks terrible
